builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Sion: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (666 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 58.4% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A scaling-health frontline fighter who uses slows to set up charged Q and long-distance R engages. His death-state attacks offer a final damage window but cannot replace staying alive for control. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Hollow Radiance → Unending Despair → Jak'Sho, The Protean. Grasp of the Undying keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Thornmail, Spirit Visage.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Hollow Radiance → Unending Despair → Jak'Sho, The Protean, with Grasp of the Undying.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Hollow Radiance → Unending Despair → Jak'Sho, The Protean) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 58.4% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Hollow Radiance → Unending Despair → Jak'Sho, The Protean.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula: Sion fires a shockwave, dealing [65 / 100 / 135 / 170 / 205 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage, Slowing them by [40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60]% for [2.5] seconds and removing [25]% Armor for [4] seconds. Non-champions hit are Knocked Back. Enemies hit by a Knocked Back unit take the same damage and effects.

Passive: Sion gains [4] max Health when he kills a unit, or [15] for champion takedowns, large minions and large monsters.

Active: Sion gains [60 / 75 / 90 / 105 / 120 + (0.4) × AP + (0.08 / 0.1 / 0.12 / 0.14 / 0.16) × Stat(12)] Shield for 6 seconds. After [3] seconds if the shield still holds, Sion can Recast to detonate the shield to deal [40 / 65 / 90 / 115 / 140 + (0.4) × AP] plus [14]% max Health magic damage.

After being killed Sion will reanimate himself allowing him to move and Attack, but his Health rapidly decays while he is reanimated. He also gains [100]% Lifesteal, attacks extremely fast, and his Attacks deal an additional [10]% max Health physical damage.

All of his Abilities are replaced with Death Surge, which grants him a burst of Move Speed.

Sion charges Unstoppably in a direction for 8 seconds, turning towards the mouse cursor. Sion stops on colliding with an enemy champion or wall or on Recasting this Ability.  

At the end of the charge, Sion deals between [150 / 300 / 450 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] and [400 / 800 / 1200 + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage based on distance travelled. Enemies close to Sion are Stunned for between [0.75] and [1.75] seconds based on distance travelled. Enemies in a larger area are Slowed by [40 / 45 / 50]% for 3 seconds.

Begin Charging: Sion charges a heavy blow for up to 2 seconds.

Release: Sion slams his axe down, briefly Slowing and dealing between [30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90 + (0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8) × AD] and [90 / 155 / 220 / 285 / 350 + (1.2 / 1.5 / 1.8 / 2.1 / 2.4) × AD] physical damage based on charge time. If Sion charged for at least 1 second, enemies are Knocked Up and Stunned for between [1.25] and 2.25 seconds based on charge time.

builds.name: Soul Furnace AP fortress
builds.summary: Test soul furnace ap fortress against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test soul furnace ap fortress against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Soul Furnace has 0.4 AP shield/detonation terms and 14% target max-health magic damage; E supplies 0.55 AP magic poke. Riftmaker and Visage support surviving the mandatory three seconds before W detonation, with health from actual W farming recorded rather than assumed infinite.
testPlan: Required state: Shield survives three seconds and E hits a useful target.
Measure W survival and damage with recorded farm-health stacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Focus fire breaks W before detonation and AP leaves Q/R physical damage weak.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: A broken shield cannot detonate and AP does not increase W's documented percent-health component.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Riftmaker, Liandry's Torment, Rabadon's Deathcap, Abyssal Mask, Spirit Visage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Magic matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Sion: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A scaling-health frontline fighter who uses slows to set up charged Q and long-distance R engages. His death-state attacks offer a final damage window but cannot replace staying alive for control. Fix earned W health and Q charge time. A physical burst/death-state route is a risky experiment; deaths and waves lost remain costs rather than free damage opportunities. MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
builds.summary: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Sion: Fix earned W health and Q charge time. A physical burst/death-state route is a risky experiment; deaths and waves lost remain costs rather than free damage opportunities.

Start with the early core (Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.

The route fails Sion's stated kit question: Fix earned W health and Q charge time. A physical burst/death-state route is a risky experiment; deaths and waves lost remain costs rather than free damage opportunities.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.
Full cost 15,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Abyssal Mask, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Reanimation attack closer
builds.summary: Test reanimation attack closer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test reanimation attack closer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Glory in Death grants rapid attacks, lifesteal and 10% target max-health physical attack damage; Blade and Titanic test a post-death finisher after an AD/health living phase. Bloodmail supports Q's large charged total-AD ratio, while E armor reduction assists both phases.
testPlan: Required state: Reach the victim alive, then remain close after death.
Record living Q damage and post-death attack damage separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Rapid decay and kiting end the reanimated phase before attacks connect.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Do not assume item actives remain usable or death grants infinite posthumous health.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Titanic Hydra, Overlord's Bloodmail, Black Cleaver, Death's Dance, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
